q1_issues.issue: 'the lanterns are lit' is a grouped definite plural with a distributive predicate (each lantern is lit individually) but gets only the group event — the per-member (Implication (PartOf $x sk_lanterns_1) (And (Member (sk_light $x) light) (Patient (sk_light $x) $x))) rule the same doctrine produced for the traders is missing, an asymmetry within the one parse.

notes: Phrasal verb kept whole as sail_out with no genus, both definite plurals as group witnesses, the agentless passive omitting its Agent, 'lit' lemmatized to light, the unmarked habitual tense, and the temporal connective taking (Before <earlier> <later>) with no connective atom are all correct.
